name: @omp-dev-team/token-diet
description: Token-reduction toolkit for OMP: ctx-wire + CodeGraph + caveman + yagni.
comment: Ships the CodeGraph MCP server (enabled by default in .mcp.json), an always-on rule, a config.snippet.yml that enables skill commands, and four skills (codegraph, caveman, yagni, token-diet). ctx-wire (transparent command-output compression) is installed by install.sh via PATH shims in ~/.local/bin. No omp.extensions.
